findings.text: Synchronous cancel registration groups address addr, descriptor fd, flags, timeout and operation code opcode with trailing reserves pad and pad2. Widths are 64 for address, signed 32 for descriptor, 32 for flags, kernel timespec for timeout, 8 for opcode, seven bytes plus three 64 bit slots for growth.

File range io_uring_file_index_range holds offset off and length len as 32 each plus 64 reserve resv. Receive output io_uring_recvmsg_out holds four 32 counts namelen controllen payloadlen and flags for name control payload and status.

Socket operations number six sequential values from zero with shared prefix SOCKET_URING_OP. Order is SIOCINQ then SIOCOUTQ then GETSOCKOPT then SETSOCKOPT then TX_TIMESTAMP then GETSOCKNAME covering queue sizes options timestamp and local address.
IORING_TIMESTAMP_HW_SHIFT denotes 16 and IORING_TIMESTAMP_TYPE_SHIFT denotes one above that. IORING_CQE_F_TSTAMP_HW denotes a 32 bit one shifted by the hardware shift.
Structure io_timespec carries seconds tv_sec and nanoseconds tv_nsec each as unsigned 64.

Structure io_uring_bpf_ctx starts with user_data opcode sqe_flags pdu_size and padding. A variant then selects socket with family type protocol, open with flags mode resolve as 64 each, or connect with family port and address union for version 4 or 6.

Connect fields are populated only when supplied address length covers them and otherwise remain zero from caller side clearing. Port and version 4 address use network order and family is zero extended. Filters may issue only word absolute loads at 4 byte aligned offsets and must mask for narrower fields.
IO_URING_BPF_FILTER_DENY_REST is 1 meaning unset opcodes get deny. IO_URING_BPF_FILTER_SZ_STRICT is 2 meaning size mismatch fails registration. IO_URING_BPF_CMD_FILTER is 1 for filter command type.

Structure io_uring_bpf_filter carries opcode flags instruction count filter_len expected size pdu_size reserves and 64 pointer filter_ptr plus five 64 reserves. Outer io_uring_bpf carries 16 command type cmd_type and flags cmd_flags with 32 reserve and a union holding the filter.

Mock capability enumeration orders IORING_MOCK_FEAT_CMD_COPY then IORING_MOCK_FEAT_RW_ZERO then IORING_MOCK_FEAT_RW_NOWAIT then IORING_MOCK_FEAT_RW_ASYNC then IORING_MOCK_FEAT_POLL then IORING_MOCK_FEAT_END.

IORING_MOCK_CREATE_F_SUPPORT_NOWAIT is 1 and IORING_MOCK_CREATE_F_POLL is 2. IORING_MOCK_MGR_CMD_PROBE is zero and IORING_MOCK_MGR_CMD_CREATE is one. IORING_MOCK_CMD_COPY_REGBUF is zero and IORING_MOCK_COPY_FROM is one.

Structure io_uring_mock_probe returns 64 feature mask plus nine 64 reserves. Structure io_uring_mock_create returns output descriptor out_fd with flags file_size delay rw_delay_ns and thirteen 64 reserves.
Structure io_uring_query_hdr chains entries with next pointer next_entry and payload pointer query_data plus operation query_op size signed result and three 32 reserves.
IO_URING_QUERY_OPCODES is zero and IO_URING_QUERY_ZCRX is one and IO_URING_QUERY_SCQ is two and IO_URING_QUERY_ZCRX_EVENT is three followed by marker __IO_URING_QUERY_MAX.

Structure io_uring_query_opcode reports request register and query counts plus 64 masks for features ring setup enter and submission flags. Structure io_uring_query_zcrx reports register and area masks control count features and refill header size with alignment. Event variant reports flag mask statistics size and alignment. SCQ variant reports header size and alignment as 64 each.

Structures io_uring_zcrx_rqe and io_uring_zcrx_cqe pair 64 offset off with length or pad. Structure io_uring_zcrx_offsets holds head tail and refill index as 32 each with reserves. Structure io_uring_zcrx_area_reg holds address addr length len token rq_area_token flags and dmabuf descriptor dmabuf_fd with two 64 reserves.

IORING_ZCRX_AREA_SHIFT is 48 and IORING_ZCRX_AREA_MASK keeps upper bits. IORING_ZCRX_AREA_DMABUF is 1. ZCRX_REG_IMPORT is 1 and ZCRX_REG_NODEV is 2 for copy only without device. ZCRX_FEATURE_RX_PAGE_SIZE is bit 0 and ZCRX_FEATURE_EVENT is bit 1. ZCRX_EVENT_ALLOC_FAIL is zero and ZCRX_EVENT_COPY is one before marker __ZCRX_EVENT_TYPE_LAST. ZCRX_EVENT_DESC_FLAG_STATS is bit 0.

Structure zcrx_stats counts cumulative copies and bytes. Structure zcrx_event_desc carries user_data type mask flags and statistics offset stats_offset plus nine 64 reserves. Structure io_uring_zcrx_ifq_reg carries interface index and queue entry count flags area and region pointers offset block identifier receive length and event descriptor with two 64 reserves.

Control operations are ZCRX_CTRL_FLUSH_RQ zero then ZCRX_CTRL_EXPORT one then ZCRX_CTRL_ARM_EVENT two then ZCRX_CTRL_ADD_AREA three before marker __ZCRX_CTRL_LAST. Flush holds only reserves, export holds descriptor, arm holds event type, add area holds area pointer. Outer zcrx_ctrl holds identifier and operation with two 64 reserves and a union of the four variants.

IOMMUFD_TYPE is semicolon. IOMMUFD_CMD_BASE is 0x80 shared with destroy, then values ascend sequentially to 0x95 for no-IOMMU address query, covering address space mapping option hardware table fault and virtual device operations.

Address space ioctls pair common type with distinct numbers. Sequence is IOMMU_DESTROY then IOMMU_IOAS_ALLOC then IOMMU_IOAS_ALLOW_IOVAS then IOMMU_IOAS_COPY then IOMMU_IOAS_IOVA_RANGES then IOMMU_IOAS_MAP then IOMMU_IOAS_UNMAP then IOMMU_OPTION then IOMMU_VFIO_IOAS then IOMMU_IOAS_MAP_FILE.

Advanced ioctls use same construction. Sequence is IOMMU_HWPT_ALLOC then IOMMU_GET_HW_INFO then IOMMU_HWPT_SET_DIRTY_TRACKING then IOMMU_HWPT_GET_DIRTY_BITMAP then IOMMU_HWPT_INVALIDATE then IOMMU_FAULT_QUEUE_ALLOC then IOMMU_VIOMMU_ALLOC then IOMMU_VDEVICE_ALLOC then IOMMU_IOAS_CHANGE_PROCESS then IOMMU_IOAS_NOIOMMU_GET_PA.

Structures iommu_destroy iommu_ioas_alloc iommu_iova_range iommu_ioas_iova_ranges and iommu_ioas_allow_iovas share size first. Destroy adds identifier, allocation adds flags and output identifier, range pair holds start last, queries hold space identifier count and pointer with alignment output only for range query.

Structures iommu_ioas_map iommu_ioas_noiommu_get_pa iommu_ioas_map_file iommu_ioas_copy and iommu_ioas_unmap share size and space identifiers. Mapping adds flags user address length and IOVA, no-IOMMU query adds output physical address, file variant uses descriptor fd with file offset, copy uses source and destination IOVAs, unmap uses IOVA with length.

IOMMU_IOAS_MAP_FIXED_IOVA is bit 0 then IOMMU_IOAS_MAP_WRITEABLE is bit 1 then IOMMU_IOAS_MAP_READABLE is bit 2. IOMMU_OPTION_RLIMIT_MODE is zero then IOMMU_OPTION_HUGE_PAGES is one. IOMMU_OPTION_OP_SET is zero then IOMMU_OPTION_OP_GET is one. IOMMU_VFIO_IOAS_GET is zero then IOMMU_VFIO_IOAS_SET is one then IOMMU_VFIO_IOAS_CLEAR is two.
Structure iommu_option holds size option identifier 16 operation object identifier and 64 value. Structure iommu_vfio_ioas holds size space identifier and 16 operation with reserve.

IOMMU_HWPT_ALLOC_NEST_PARENT is bit 0 then IOMMU_HWPT_ALLOC_DIRTY_TRACKING is bit 1 then IOMMU_HWPT_FAULT_ID_VALID is bit 2 then IOMMU_HWPT_ALLOC_PASID is bit 3. IOMMU_VTD_S1_SRE is bit 0 then IOMMU_VTD_S1_EAFE is bit 1 then IOMMU_VTD_S1_WPE is bit 2. IOMMU_HWPT_DATA_NONE is zero then IOMMU_HWPT_DATA_VTD_S1 is one then IOMMU_HWPT_DATA_ARM_SMMUV3 is two then IOMMU_HWPT_DATA_AMD_GUEST is three.

Structure iommu_hwpt_vtd_s1 holds flags and table address as aligned 64 with address width. Structure iommu_hwpt_arm_smmuv3 holds two little endian stream entries. Structure iommu_hwpt_amd_guest holds four aligned directory entries. Structure iommu_hwpt_alloc holds size flags device and table identifiers output identifier data type length and user pointer plus fault identifier.

Structure iommu_hw_info_vtd holds flags and capability registers. Structure iommu_hw_info_arm_smmuv3 holds flags six identifier registers IIDR and AIDR. Tegra variant holds flags version and log sizes. AMD variant holds two feature registers. Main iommu_hw_info holds size flags device data length and pointer plus a union for input or output type max PASID log and capabilities.

IOMMU_HW_INFO_TYPE_NONE and IOMMU_HW_INFO_TYPE_DEFAULT are zero then IOMMU_HW_INFO_TYPE_INTEL_VTD is one then IOMMU_HW_INFO_TYPE_ARM_SMMUV3 is two then IOMMU_HW_INFO_TYPE_TEGRA241_CMDQV is three then IOMMU_HW_INFO_TYPE_AMD is four. IOMMU_HW_CAP_DIRTY_TRACKING is bit 0 then IOMMU_HW_CAP_PCI_PASID_EXEC is bit 1 then IOMMU_HW_CAP_PCI_PASID_PRIV is bit 2 then IOMMU_HW_CAP_PCI_ATS_NOT_SUPPORTED is bit 3.
IOMMU_HW_INFO_FLAG_INPUT_TYPE is bit 0. IOMMU_HW_INFO_VTD_ERRATA_772415_SPR17 is bit 0. IOMMU_HW_INFO_ARM_SMMUV3_ERRATA_REPEAT_TLBI_CFGI is bit 0.
IOMMU_HWPT_DIRTY_TRACKING_ENABLE is 1. IOMMU_HWPT_GET_DIRTY_BITMAP_NO_CLEAR is 1.

Structure iommu_hwpt_set_dirty_tracking holds size flags table identifier and reserve. Structure iommu_hwpt_get_dirty_bitmap holds size table identifier flags plus IOVA length page size and output pointer data.
IOMMU_HWPT_INVALIDATE_DATA_VTD_S1 is zero and IOMMU_VIOMMU_INVALIDATE_DATA_ARM_SMMUV3 is one. IOMMU_VTD_INV_FLAGS_LEAF is bit 0.

Structure iommu_hwpt_vtd_s1_invalidate holds address and page count as aligned 64 with flags. Structure iommu_viommu_arm_smmuv3_invalidate holds two little endian commands. Outer iommu_hwpt_invalidate holds size table identifier user pointer data type entry length and count.

IOMMU_PGFAULT_FLAGS_PASID_VALID is bit 0 and IOMMU_PGFAULT_FLAGS_LAST_PAGE is bit 1. IOMMU_PGFAULT_PERM_READ is bit 0 then IOMMU_PGFAULT_PERM_WRITE is bit 1 then IOMMU_PGFAULT_PERM_EXEC is bit 2 then IOMMU_PGFAULT_PERM_PRIV is bit 3. IOMMUFD_PAGE_RESP_SUCCESS is zero and IOMMUFD_PAGE_RESP_INVALID is one.

Structure iommu_hwpt_pgfault holds flags device PASID group permission plus address length and cookie. Structure iommu_hwpt_page_response pairs cookie with code. Structure iommu_fault_alloc holds size flags and outputs fault identifier and descriptor.

Virtual IOMMU types are IOMMU_VIOMMU_TYPE_DEFAULT zero then IOMMU_VIOMMU_TYPE_ARM_SMMUV3 one then IOMMU_VIOMMU_TYPE_TEGRA241_CMDQV two with Tegra needing hypervisor owned clear. Tegra output holds mapping offset and length. Allocation holds size flags type device and table identifiers output identifier data length and pointer. Virtual device holds size virtual and physical identifiers output identifier and virtual identifier. Process change holds only size.
IOMMU_VEVENTQ_FLAG_LOST_EVENTS is bit 0. IOMMU_VEVENTQ_TYPE_DEFAULT is zero then IOMMU_VEVENTQ_TYPE_ARM_SMMUV3 is one then IOMMU_VEVENTQ_TYPE_TEGRA241_CMDQV is two.

Structure iommufd_vevent_header pairs flags with sequence. Structure iommu_vevent_arm_smmuv3 holds four little endian entries. Structure iommu_vevent_tegra241_cmdqv holds two little endian error maps.

All iommufd commands start with 32 size for versioning followed by identifiers and flags, with explicit reserves and aligned 64 for pointers lengths and addresses to keep 32 and 64 layouts stable. Query and ZCRX families use the same reserve discipline with size plus alignment reporting.

Iommufd objects move from allocation returning identifiers through use by identifier to destruction. Dirty tracking enables then bitmap queries with optional no clear. Invalidate dispatches by data type and entry array. Faults flow from report with cookie to response with code. ZCRX moves from area and queue registration through refill and control operations with event arming. Query chains via next entry until zero.

Many structures carry user pointers with separate lengths that must be validated for size and alignment, including BPF filter query chaining ZCRX area and region plus IOMMU data and bitmap buffers. Descriptors for dmabuf mock output and fault queues need lifetime handling. Reserved fields must be zero. Network order and little endian arrays must not be swapped incorrectly.

Headers expose stable user interfaces for io_uring extensions including cancel socket operations timestamps BPF filtering mock testing capability queries and zero copy receive, plus IOMMU descriptor management for address spaces page tables faults and virtualization.

Padding and explicitly named reserve members such as pad resv and double underscore variants hold no meaning and must be zero on input and ignored or zero on output to preserve forward compatibility and deterministic layout.
Each header defines a unique inclusion guard so repeated inclusion is idempotent and has no behavioral effect beyond preventing redefinition.
